conclusion: Skip single-group archetype assignment; preserve full generation bits and independently owned arrays. CPU generation timing only; audit16 remains open.
limitations: Device-specific native Chrome/AMD CPU measurements; no whole-frame, FPS or universal-runtime speedup claim.
Each phase captures its own moving workload; comparisons are paired within a phase, not across RED/GREEN scenes.
Full matrix buffers are compared in the browser before/after timing; exact inputs, sources and hashes are archived, raw matrix buffers are not.
CPU profiling wrappers and DevTools sampling add overhead; CPU/GPU phase medians cannot be summed into a frame median.
Both profile screenshots were inspected for scene presence, not image equivalence.
The rejected noViewCutoffDiagnostic is intentionally unrestricted and unsafe for opaque media; neither it nor either guarded prototype is shipped.
First focused Vitest command logged all passes but PowerShell reported failure on stderr; independent shell reproduction returned nativeExit=0/powershellSuccess=False, explicit-exit retry passed.
Initial GPU harness failed to start esbuild under sandbox (spawn EPERM), preserved separately; successful retry used process permission.
reproduction: Restore exact embedded sources/supporting files into a scratch checkout with the recorded dependencies; do not overwrite historical output files.
RED requires production AsteroidGenerator from base and runner --red; guard rejects edited source. GREEN uses fixed production and runner without --red.
Original baseline module differs from Git source only in relative import routing to /src; its source snapshot is verified against Git.
Runner creates the output report exclusively, captures 96 real moving frames per scene and compares original/current on identical frozen generation calls.

sources.src/core/renderables/DetailedRingStreami:
/**
 * Профили облика астероидов (см. чанк AsteroidSurface).
 *
 * Профиль — именованный набор параметров процедурного облика. Кольцо выбирает
 * ОДИН профиль через AsteroidRingConfig.profile; AsteroidRingSystem раскладывает
 * его значения по юниформам L0-материала. Значения стартовые, тюнятся визуально.
 */
export interface AsteroidProfile {
  /** Базовый цвет породы (hex) */
  baseColor: number
  /** Амплитуда per-instance джиттера яркости (±доля) */
  colorJitter: number
  /** Сила внутриповерхностного оттеночного мотла */
  tintStrength: number
  /** Сила крупномасштабного альбедо maria/highlands (0 → выкл): затемнение
   *  базальтовых равнин относительно возвышенностей. Даёт макро-композицию. */
  mariaStrength: number
  /** Ambient-подсветка тёмной стороны */
  surfaceAmbient: number
  /** Сила specular-блика (0 → матовый) */
  specularStrength: number
  /** Жёсткость блика (большой = резкий металл) */
  specularPower: number
  /** Тинт блика: 0 белый диэлектрик → 1 под цвет металла */
  specularTint: number
  /** Осветление свежего скола разлома (см. surfaceData.x — freshness из
   *  ArchetypeShape.surfaceAt): меньше налипшего реголита на недавнем изломе.
   *  Лёд заметно светлеет на сколах — выше остальных пород. */
  freshnessBrighten: number
  /** Затенение днищ кратерных чаш (см. surfaceData.y — cavity):
   *  самозатенение AO глубоких впадин от запечённого рельефа. */
  cavityShade: number
  /**
   * Доля Ломмеля-Зелигера в диффузе (см. чанк AsteroidBrdf): 0 — Ламберт
   * («пластиковый шар»), 1 — реголит, ровный по диску с резким лимбом. Тёмный
   * пылевой реголит (углистые) ближе к 1, металл с гладкими сколами — к Ламберту.
   */
  lunarMix: number
  /** Сила оппозиционного пика при взгляде со стороны звезды (0 — нет) */
  oppositionSurge: number
  /**
   * Пропорции морфологий в библиотеке архетипов породы (сумма ≈ 1):
   * fragment — осколок Вороного (свежий скол/удар), rubble — слипшиеся
   * лобы (гравитационная переупаковка), binary — контактная двойная с
   * перемычкой (Итокава), top — волчок с экваториальным гребнем (Бенну),
   * cratered — монолит с чашами (старая поверхность). Каменные/углистые тела
   * чаще дробятся при столкновениях (выше fragment/rubble); металл держит
   * форму монолита и волчков из щебня не образует (top 0); лёд колется свежими
   * расколами чаще, чем накапливает rubble-переупаковку. Порядок ключей задаёт
   * раскладку индексов библиотеки (см. ArchetypeLibrary.MORPHOLOGY_ORDER).
   */
  morphologyWeights: {
    fragment: number
    rubble: number
    binary: number
    top: number
    cratered: number
  }
  /**
   * Реальные модели форм малых тел (имена бинарников `asteroids/shapes/<имя>_*.bin`,
   * см. ShapeModelFormat и scripts/build-shape-models.ts). Занимают хвост
   * библиотеки архетипов долей realShare, список идёт по кругу, если слотов
   * больше моделей. Подбор по породе: каменные и углистые — астероиды своих
   * спектральных классов, металл — M-класс, лёд — малые ледяные спутники.
   */
  shapeModels: string[]
  /** Доля библиотеки под реальные модели, 0..1 (0 — только процедурные) */
  realShare: number
  /**
   * Базовое имя PBR-сета трипланарных детальных карт (файлы вида
   * `asteroids/<detailSet>_{diff,nor_gl,arm}_2k.jpg`). Сет пер-профильный,
   * потому что задаёт ФАКТУРУ породы (трещины/крошка/плиты) — независимо
   * от него цвет всё равно грейдится через uRockColor (baseColor выше).
   * Ледяные тела получают собственную структуру поверхности (глыбы льда
   * с трещинами) вместо общей каменной.
   */
  detailSet: string
}

export type AsteroidProfileName = 'stony' | 'carbonaceous' | 'metallic' | 'icy'

export const ASTEROID_PROFILES: Record<AsteroidProfileName, AsteroidProfile> = {
  // Силикатный/каменный — матовый серо-коричневый, дефолт
  stony: {
    baseColor: 0x6b6157, colorJitter: 0.12, tintStrength: 0.25, mariaStrength: 0.3,
    surfaceAmbient: 0.03,
    specularStrength: 0.05, specularPower: 8.0, specularTint: 0.0,
    freshnessBrighten: 0.15, cavityShade: 0.5,
    lunarMix: 0.8, oppositionSurge: 0.3,
    morphologyWeights: { fragment: 0.5, rubble: 0.2, binary: 0.1, top: 0.05, cratered: 0.15 },
    shapeModels: ['itokawa', 'eros', 'gaspra', 'ida', 'steins', 'lutetia', 'toutatis'],
    realShare: 0.5,
    detailSet: 'rock_boulder_dry'
  },
  // Углистый — очень тёмный, матовый
  carbonaceous: {
    baseColor: 0x2b2824, colorJitter: 0.08, tintStrength: 0.2, mariaStrength: 0.22,
    surfaceAmbient: 0.02,
    specularStrength: 0.0, specularPower: 8.0, specularTint: 0.0,
    freshnessBrighten: 0.1, cavityShade: 0.5,
    lunarMix: 0.9, oppositionSurge: 0.4,
    morphologyWeights: { fragment: 0.4, rubble: 0.3, binary: 0.1, top: 0.05, cratered: 0.15 },
    shapeModels: ['bennu', 'mathilde'],
    realShare: 0.5,
    detailSet: 'rock_boulder_dry'
  },
  // Железный — тёплый серый, резкий окрашенный блик
  metallic: {
    baseColor: 0x8a8079, colorJitter: 0.1, tintStrength: 0.15, mariaStrength: 0.14,
    surfaceAmbient: 0.04,
    specularStrength: 0.6, specularPower: 48.0, specularTint: 0.8,
    freshnessBrighten: 0.2, cavityShade: 0.5,
    lunarMix: 0.4, oppositionSurge: 0.15,
    morphologyWeights: { fragment: 0.65, rubble: 0.1, binary: 0.1, top: 0, cratered: 0.15 },
    shapeModels: ['kleopatra'],
    realShare: 0.5,
    detailSet: 'rock_boulder_dry'
  },
  // Ледяной — голубовато-белый, мягкий блик
  icy: {
    baseColor: 0xc4d2dc, colorJitter: 0.06, tintStrength: 0.12, mariaStrength: 0.2,
    surfaceAmbient: 0.06,
    specularStrength: 0.5, specularPower: 12.0, specularTint: 0.0,
    freshnessBrighten: 0.3, cavityShade: 0.35,
    lunarMix: 0.5, oppositionSurge: 0.2,
    morphologyWeights: { fragment: 0.6, rubble: 0.15, binary: 0.1, top: 0.05, cratered: 0.1 },
    shapeModels: ['epimetheus', 'janus', 'pandora', 'prometheus', 'phobos', 'deimos'],
    realShare: 0.5,
    detailSet: 'rocks_ground_04'
  }
}

/**
 * Валидирует имя профиля, пришедшее строкой из данных (JSON редактора) —
 * незнакомое имя тихо становится fallback (по умолчанию 'stony'), чтобы
 * опечатка не роняла рендер. Общий гейт для колец (AsteroidRingSystem) и
 * пояса (AsteroidBelt); ледяная примесь пояса подставляет свой fallback.
 */
export function asteroidProfileNameOf(name: string, fallback: AsteroidProfileName = 'stony'): AsteroidProfileName {
  return name in ASTEROID_PROFILES ? (name as AsteroidProfileName) : fallback
}

const normalize = text => text.replaceAll('\r\n', '\n')
const digest = data => createHash('sha256').update(data).digest('hex')
const read = path => {
  const data = readFileSync(path)
  return data[0] === 255 && data[1] === 254 ? data.subarray(2).toString('utf16le') : data.toString('utf8').replace(/^\uFEFF/, '')
}
const json = path => JSON.parse(read(path))
const cleanLog = path => read(path).replace(/\x1b\[[0-9;]*m/g, '')
const original = read(root + 'single-archetype-baseline-2026-10-27.source.txt')
const inserted = '    // Flat billboard generation has one destination for every instance. Keep\n    // the fresh zero-filled array; no hash or separate morphology RNG is needed.\n    if (archetypeCount === 1) return archetypeOf\n'
const sources = [production, test, 'package.json', 'vite.config.ts', 'playwright.config.ts',
  ...['SeededRandom', 'AsteroidProfiles', 'SectorGrid', 'SectorManager', 'InstancePool', 'RadialDensityProfile', 'AngularDensityProfile', 'triangularMass', 'archetypes/ArchetypeLibrary'].map(name => `src/core/renderables/DetailedRingStreamingSystem/${name}.ts`),

    'prepare-sector-parts-2026-10-27.mjs', 'sector-parts-motion-2026-10-27.browser.ts', 'run-sector-parts-motion-2026-10-27.mjs',
    'prepare-single-archetype-2026-10-27.mjs', 'single-archetype-baseline-2026-10-27.source.txt', 'single-archetype-baseline-2026-10-27.ts',

    'run-single-archetype-verification-2026-10-27.ps1', 'archive-single-archetype-2026-10-27.mjs'].map(name => root + name)
]

  assert.equal(normalize(original), normalize(execFileSync('git', ['show', `${base}:${production}`], { encoding: 'utf8' })))
  assert.equal(normalize(read(production)).replace(inserted, ''), normalize(original))
  assert.equal(read(root + 'single-archetype-baseline-2026-10-27.ts'), original.replaceAll("from './", "from '/src/core/renderables/DetailedRingStreamingSystem/"))
  for (const entry of archive.provenance) {
    const bytes = readFileSync(entry.path)
    assert.equal(digest(bytes), entry.sha256, entry.path); assert.equal(bytes.length, entry.bytes, entry.path)
  }
  for (const [path, text] of Object.entries(archive.sources)) assert.equal(read(path), text, path)
  for (const path of sources.filter(path => path.startsWith('src/') && path !== production)) {
    assert.equal(normalize(read(path)), normalize(execFileSync('git', ['show', `${base}:${path}`], { encoding: 'utf8' })), path)
  }
  const red = archive.performance.red, green = archive.performance.green
  assert.deepEqual(red, json(root + 'single-archetype-red-2026-10-27.json'))
  assert.deepEqual(green, json(root + 'single-archetype-green-2026-10-27.json'))
  for (const report of [red, green]) {
    checkClean(report)
    assert.equal(report.baselineCommit, base)
    assert.equal(report.sourceHashes.original, digest(Buffer.from(original)))
    assert.equal(report.sourceHashes.current, digest(Buffer.from(report === red ? original : read(production))))
    assert.deepEqual(report.rows.map(row => row.id), [13, 12])
    for (const row of report.rows) {
      assert.deepEqual(row.summary.baseline, stats(row.samples.baseline))
      assert.deepEqual(row.summary.current, stats(row.samples.current))
      assert.equal(row.improvement, 1 - row.summary.current.p50 / row.summary.baseline.p50)
      assert.equal(row.gate, row.improvement >= 0.1)
      assert.equal(row.capture.frames, 96); assert.equal(row.capture.calls, row.calls.length)
      assert.equal(row.capture.instances, row.calls.reduce((sum, call) => sum + call.count, 0))
      assert.equal(row.parity.bytesPerComparison, row.capture.instances * 64)
      assert.equal(row.parity.comparisons, 4); assert.equal(row.parity.identicalToLive, true); assert.equal(row.parity.beforeAndAfter, true)
      assert.equal(row.parity.inputsSha256, digest(Buffer.from(JSON.stringify({ inputs: row.inputs, calls: row.calls }))))
      assert.match(row.parity.liveSha256, /^[0-9a-f]{64}$/)
      assert.ok(row.calls.every(call => call.frame >= 0 && call.frame < 96 && row.inputs[call.owner]))
      assert.doesNotMatch(row.snapshot.renderer, /SwiftShader|software|llvmpipe/i)
    }
  }
  assert.equal(red.outcome, 'performance-gate-failed'); assert.ok(red.rows.every(row => !row.gate))
  assert.equal(green.outcome, 'completed'); assert.ok(green.rows.every(row => row.gate))
  for (let i = 0; i < 2; i++) {
    assert.equal(red.rows[i].parity.inputsSha256, green.rows[i].parity.inputsSha256)
    assert.equal(red.rows[i].parity.liveSha256, green.rows[i].parity.liveSha256)
    assert.equal(green.rows[i].samples.baseline.filter((ms, j) => ms > green.rows[i].samples.current[j]).length, [32, 30][i])
  }
  const rejected = json(root + 'nebula-view-bound-diagnosis-2026-10-27.json')
  assert.deepEqual(archive.rejectedGpu, rejected); checkClean(rejected); assert.equal(rejected.outcome, 'completed')
  for (const scene of rejected.rows) for (const row of scene.rows) {
    assert.deepEqual(row.summary, stats(row.samples))
    assert.equal(row.image.color.differentBits, 0); assert.equal(row.image.position.differentBits, 0)
  }
  const profile = json(root + 'sector-parts-motion-2026-10-27.json')
  checkClean(profile); assert.equal(profile.outcome, 'completed')
  assert.deepEqual(archive.motionCpu.rows, profile.rows.map(row => ({ id: row.id, view: row.view, initial: row.initial, final: row.final, frames: row.frames,
    summary: row.summary, cpu: row.cpu, detail: row.detail, detailSummary: row.detailSummary, visibilityCpu: row.visibilityCpu })))
  assert.deepEqual(archive.verification.steps, json(root + 'single-archetype-verification-2026-10-27.json'))
  assert.deepEqual(archive.verification.steps.map(step => [step.name, step.exitCode]), [['full-test', 0], ['lint', 0], ['build', 0], ['full-browser', 0]])
  assert.match(cleanLog(root + 'single-archetype-baseline-unit-2026-10-27.log'), /Tests\s+10 passed/)
  assert.match(cleanLog(root + 'single-archetype-focused-unit-2026-10-27.log'), /Tests\s+681 passed\s*\|\s*1 skipped/)
  assert.match(cleanLog(root + 'single-archetype-full-test-2026-10-27.log'), /Tests\s+5600 passed\s*\|\s*7 skipped/)
  assert.match(cleanLog(root + 'single-archetype-full-test-2026-10-27.log'), /Test Files\s+559 passed\s*\|\s*2 skipped/)
  assert.match(cleanLog(root + 'single-archetype-build-2026-10-27.log'), /built in/)
  const browser = json(root + 'single-archetype-full-browser-2026-10-27.json')
  assert.deepEqual(archive.verification.browserStats, browser.stats)
  assert.equal(browser.stats.expected, 48); assert.equal(browser.stats.unexpected, 0); assert.equal(browser.stats.flaky, 0); assert.equal(browser.stats.skipped, 0)
  assert.equal(browser.errors.length, 0)
  if (archive.review) assert.deepEqual(archive.review, json(root + 'single-archetype-review-2026-10-27.json'))
  console.log(JSON.stringify({ verified: archive.provenance.length, green: green.rows.map(row => ({ id: row.id, improvement: row.improvement, calls: row.capture.calls, instances: row.capture.instances })), unitPass: 5600, browserPass: 48, review: Boolean(archive.review) }))
}

if (process.argv.includes('--verify')) verify(json(output))
else {
  const reviewPath = root + 'single-archetype-review-2026-10-27.json'
  const profile = json(root + 'sector-parts-motion-2026-10-27.json')
  const paths = [...sources, ...evidenceFiles, ...(existsSync(reviewPath) ? [reviewPath] : [])]
  const archive = {
    schema: 1, base, createdAt: new Date().toISOString(), production,
    runtime: { node: process.version, platform: process.platform, arch: process.arch,
      dependencies: Object.fromEntries(['three', 'vite', 'vitest', '@playwright/test'].map(name => [name, json(`node_modules/${name}/package.json`).version])) },
    conclusion: 'Skip single-group archetype assignment; preserve full generation bits and independently owned arrays. CPU generation timing only; audit16 remains open.',
    limitations: [
      'Device-specific native Chrome/AMD CPU measurements; no whole-frame, FPS or universal-runtime speedup claim.',
      'Each phase captures its own moving workload; comparisons are paired within a phase, not across RED/GREEN scenes.',
      'Full matrix buffers are compared in the browser before/after timing; exact inputs, sources and hashes are archived, raw matrix buffers are not.',
      'CPU profiling wrappers and DevTools sampling add overhead; CPU/GPU phase medians cannot be summed into a frame median.',
      'Both profile screenshots were inspected for scene presence, not image equivalence.',
      'The rejected noViewCutoffDiagnostic is intentionally unrestricted and unsafe for opaque media; neither it nor either guarded prototype is shipped.',
      'First focused Vitest command logged all passes but PowerShell reported failure on stderr; independent shell reproduction returned nativeExit=0/powershellSuccess=False, explicit-exit retry passed.',
      'Initial GPU harness failed to start esbuild under sandbox (spawn EPERM), preserved separately; successful retry used process permission.'
    ],
    reproduction: [
      'Restore exact embedded sources/supporting files into a scratch checkout with the recorded dependencies; do not overwrite historical output files.',
      'RED requires production AsteroidGenerator from base and runner --red; guard rejects edited source. GREEN uses fixed production and runner without --red.',
      'Original baseline module differs from Git source only in relative import routing to /src; its source snapshot is verified against Git.',
      'Runner creates the output report exclusively, captures 96 real moving frames per scene and compares original/current on identical frozen generation calls.'
    ],
    sources: Object.fromEntries(sources.map(path => [path, read(path)])),
    provenance: paths.map(path => { const bytes = readFileSync(path); return { path, bytes: bytes.length, sha256: digest(bytes) } }),
    performance: { red: json(root + 'single-archetype-red-2026-10-27.json'), green: json(root + 'single-archetype-green-2026-10-27.json') },
    rejectedGpu: json(root + 'nebula-view-bound-diagnosis-2026-10-27.json'),
    motionCpu: { outcome: profile.outcome, rows: profile.rows.map(row => ({ id: row.id, view: row.view, initial: row.initial, final: row.final, frames: row.frames,
      summary: row.summary, cpu: row.cpu, detail: row.detail, detailSummary: row.detailSummary, visibilityCpu: row.visibilityCpu })) },
    verification: { steps: json(root + 'single-archetype-verification-2026-10-27.json'), browserStats: json(root + 'single-archetype-full-browser-2026-10-27.json').stats },
    review: existsSync(reviewPath) ? json(reviewPath) : null
  }
  verify(archive)
  writeFileSync(output, JSON.stringify(archive, null, 2) + '\n')
}
